name: KTM 125 / 150 / 250 SX (two-stroke)
engine: 124 to 249 cc liquid-cooled two-stroke single, carb then injection on newer years, premix
intro: KTM's motocross two-strokes. Premix on most years, a power valve, and top ends that need regular rebuilds.

B: It runs on premix. Mix the oil into the fuel at the ratio in the manual.

recallNote: Off-road models are not always in the NHTSA recall search. Ask a KTM dealer to run the VIN as well.
